risks.note: Management identifies INR depreciation as the largest risk to the Company's treasury portfolio; existing hedges (small investments in global-stock funds, gold/silver exposure) are considered likely insufficient to offset this.

Since diversifying out of its long-term Hero MotoCorp holding into stocks, mutual funds, AIFs and FDs, the Company is exposed to market shocks (e.g. the US/Israel-Iran conflict caused negative March returns after 11 otherwise good months); management expects volatility to persist episodically even if returns normalise over the longer term.

The Company's historical business and remaining strategy are tied to Indian (Noida/NCR) commercial and industrial real estate, exposing it to sectoral valuation cycles, rental yield compression and local regulatory/bye-law complexity.
